name: いいねと返信操作付きのコメント
prompt:
Edit the first Japanese comment render to fit the native preview’s compact 390 × 106 px frame. The first render contains the correct text and icons but sits too low in a 2171x724 canvas with extra vertical padding. Move the row content up and tighten the outer frame so the avatar begins around y=10 and the reply label remains near the bottom at y≈78. Do not enlarge the row or create poster-like whitespace.

Keep these target positions at 390px width: 36px mint initial avatar at x=16, y=10; bold name 山田 はるか at x=68, y=8; muted 1日前 near the right end of the name row; comment at x=68, y≈37; reply label 返信する at x=68, y≈78; gray heart at the far right around y=45; gray 160 below the heart around y=82. Preserve the exact comment とてもすてきです！見ていて元気が出ます。 on two compact lines. Use crisp Japanese text and the pale-mint avatar from the native preview.

No text is a hyperlink here. Keep the name and comment dark, all metadata and heart gray, and do not color text blue. Use the native 390 × 106 preview as exact geometry reference and keep the white background.
reviewNotes: Exact localized comment and actions; the row is still too low within the 390x106 target after two attempts. No hyperlink text.
